artworks.title: Portrait of Four Men
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image depicts four men in a studio-style portrait. Three men are seated and one man is standing behind them. The seated men are shown from the waist up, while the standing man is visible from the chest up. The seated man on the left has a beard and is wearing a dark coat with a vest and bow tie. The man standing behind him has a clean-shaven face and medium-length hair, parted on the side, wearing a dark suit, white shirt, and a bow tie. The central seated man has sideburns and a sharp jawline, dressed in a dark suit with a bow tie. The seated man on the right has a clean-shaven face, a defined hairline and short hair, wearing formal dark clothing. The group is framed by an ornate patterned frame with an oval mat, against a plain dark background.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Family
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a group portrait of six individuals arranged in two rows. Three individuals are seated in the front row, while three others stand behind them. The seated woman in the center holds an open book and wears a dark dress and a white lace cap. To her left is a man in formal attire, with a bow tie and a coat, holding a book. To her right is a man in a dark suit, white shirt, and bow tie. In the back row, two women and one man stand. The women wear dark dresses with light collars, and the man has slicked-back hair. All individuals have neutral expressions. The backdrop is a simple, uniformly dark background, and the portrait is framed with an ornate border inside a decorative case.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.artist: James McClees and Washington L. Germon
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait of a middle-aged man from the chest up. He is facing slightly to the right, looking off into the distance. His facial features are defined, with prominent cheekbones and deep-set eyes. His hair is combed back and is dark with some lighter areas. He is dressed in formal clothing, wearing a dark coat and a white shirt with a high collar underneath. Around his neck is a cravat or necktie tied in a bow. The portrait is bordered by a golden oval frame within a rectangular case, and the background is plain and dark.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a portrait format framed in an oval shape with a decorative gold border. Her upper body is visible, and she is positioned facing slightly to the side, but her head is turned directly towards the camera. The woman's face is gentle with relaxed features, and she has dark hair that is centrally parted and smoothed back, mostly hidden under a white, frilly cap or bonnet. She wears a dark dress with a high collar featuring a white lace trim and a small brooch at the neck. The fabric of the dress has a textured pattern. The background is plain and dark, drawing focus to the woman in the portrait.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a double portrait of a woman. Each likeness is set in its own oval frame within a rectangular mat. Both images appear to be of the same woman, shown from the waist up. She is seated, facing slightly to the right in the first portrait and slightly to the left in the second, with her head turned towards the camera. The woman has a rounded face with smooth skin, a straight nose, and dark eyes. Her hair is styled in large coils over her ears. She wears a dark dress with a high collar featuring an intricate white lace pattern, and holds a bouquet of flowers in her left hand on her lap. The background is plain, potentially neutral or slightly dark, and the entire photograph is encased in an ornate frame with textured edging and a yellow-gold interior.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man seated, facing slightly to the right. He has distinct facial features including pronounced cheekbones and a structured jawline, with deep-set eyes. His hair is dark and styled away from his face. He wears a military uniform with ornate details such as epaulettes, a high collar, buttons, and corded embellishments. He is holding a rolled-up document in his right hand. The background includes a draped curtain with a decorative tassel hanging down. The image is framed in an ornate, gold-colored border and set in a worn wooden case.

artworks.title: Veduta della Basilica di Santa Maria Maggiore (View of the Basilica of Santa Maria Maggiore)
artworks.artist: Laura Piranesi, after Giovanni Battista Piranesi
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Kaywin Feldman
artworks.description: This print shows a view of a large basilica. In front of it is a town square that we see from a high vantage point. The basilica, including domes and a clock tower, is visible in the distance. Closet to us, a column on a pedestal is positioned slightly left of center. Other buildings and groups of people are present around the basilica and the column. The print is monochromatic, with dark lines contrasting against the light paper. It is surrounded by a border of off-white paper, and at the bottom are the words "Veduta della Basilica di S. Maria Maggiore."

artworks.title: Grèce, Les Propylées à Athènes (Greece, The Propylaea in Athens)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: The image displays a classical ruin with standing and fallen columns. The columns are arranged irregularly, some still upright while others are decaying on the ground. The horizon is visible above the ruins, showing a distant landscape. The detailing in the image shows textures of stonework and weathered surfaces. The color palette is monochromatic, in shades of grayscale. The lack of vibrant colors accentuates the contrast and form of the architectural elements.

artworks.title: Syrie, Beyrouth
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a historic cityscape with rooftops, hills, and mountains in the background. The scene includes detailed stone and brick buildings, with laundry lines and a figure on a rooftop in the foreground. A tall tower with smaller domes is also featured. The color palette is monochromatic, and the composition creates a sense of depth and nostalgia.

artworks.title: Porch of St. Laurent's Church, Nuremberg
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: The sculpture is part of a detailed Gothic cathedral door with religious figures and decorative elements. The intricate designs typical of Gothic architecture include figures carved into the stone door frame, with a dark, weathered appearance. The door is divided into panels with relief work, set within a large, pointed arch. The sculpture reaches upwards and is adorned with various carvings, showing a high level of craftsmanship.

artworks.title: Tours, Portail de L'Église Saint Symphorien (Tours, Entry of the Church of Saint Symphorien)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: This is a photograph of the entrance of a historic building. The image shows the architectural details of the building, including a large arched doorway with stone carvings and statues. Above the doorway are leaded glass windows set in a gothic-style arch, decorated with vine motifs and sculptures. The facade is made of weathered stone blocks. Steps lead to a pair of aged wooden doors at the entrance.

artworks.title: Vallée du Nahr-El-Kelb (El Kelb Valley of the Nahr)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: The image shows a rugged landscape with a river flowing through a canyon between two steep hillsides. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, looking down along the river as it winds from the foreground towards the horizon, which is approximately one-third from the top of the image. On the horizon, part of the river and the narrowing path of the canyon are visible. The left hillside is covered with dark foliage, while the right side features layered rock formations with sparse trees. The image appears to be a detailed illustration with fine brushstrokes or pencil work depicting the textures of rocks, trees, and water. The color palette is monochromatic, predominantly black, gray, and white, creating a dramatic and stark visual contrast. In the distance, there are partly cloudy skies adding depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Great Hall of the Temple at Edfou
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: This is a photograph showing intricately carved stone columns within an ancient structure. The image displays a series of massive stone columns adorned with hieroglyphics and detailed carvings of figures and symbolic elements. The columns are located in an open, spacious area of a historical site. The carvings depict a narrative, showcasing the antiquity and cultural significance of the place. The floor consists of large stone slabs, and light filtering into the space creates a subdued, rustic atmosphere, highlighting the texture and age of the stone. The photograph captures the grandeur and historical depth of ancient architecture.

artworks.title: Crabbed Age and Youth
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Katzman and Hilary Skirboll
artworks.description: The image shows a rural path with a group of men working near a thatched-roof cottage. The perspective is from the side, with the horizon high, trees in the background, and the workers close to the viewer. The men appear to be working on or near stone paving and walls. The thatched-roof cottage is on the right, and a line of trees extends on the left. The scene has a rustic and serene feel, with a monochrome palette focused on sepia tones. Textural details of the cottage, trees, and path are clearly visible.
